note: Bighorn Canyon NRA campground on an open sagebrush-and-juniper bench above Bighorn Lake, 14 mi north of Lovell off WY-37, run by a concessioner. The marina, boat ramp, swim beach and picnic area are downhill, under a mile away. No cell service. The Senior Pass discount applies only to the sites without hookups. --Claude
summary: NPS page + API: 68 sites (28 water+electric, 3 pull-through), open all year, $35 hookup / $17 other ($9 senior on non-hookup only), 10 sites reservable via Campspot (concessioner Hidden Treasure Charters), rest FCFS; flush toilets, dump, water. Campspot 403 (not retried) -> amperage and rig lengths unread. Not waterfront kept (loops 300-400 m above the lake across open ground - possible lakeview). Phone (307) 548-5406 -> (307) 899-1401.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront kept, possible UPGRADE to lakeview for the reviewer: NPS says 'the 68 campsites of the Horseshoe Bend Campground overlook the Bighorn Lake'; on imagery the loops (about 44.9625,-108.2610) sit on an open treeless bench ~300-400 m from the high-water edge of the bay south of the marina, nothing but sagebrush between - a view is likely from the south loops, but no per-site photo was read, so defaulted down.
PHONE: (307) 548-5406 -> (307) 899-1401 (Hidden Treasure Charters, named on the NPS page as the operator to contact; the NPS API also lists 307-548-7230).
